raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: Instead of retrieving the exact edit count up to June 2023 via Wikipedia’s revision history/XTools, WebSurfer approximated using an average edits-per-year and assumed uniform distribution (and inception year), producing 2,619 rather than the correct 2,732. This reliance on estimation and failure to apply the available date filter led directly to the wrong answer.
